m_staff_count_only_cross <- fenegbin (
  perYear ~ total_staff_count +
    # population_m +
     # percent_workers_government +
     # percent_education_bachelor_or_higher +
     # percent_public_assistance_or_snap_households +
    # # percent_workers_self_employed +
    # # percent_workers_private_sector +
    # # percent_workers_nonprofit +
    # electoral
    # competitive +
    # competitive_primary +
    #PACamount_m +
    # institution
    # chair +
    # subchr +
    # ranking_minority +
    #prestige +
    # oversight +
    # member level
    # state_leg +
    # experience +
     # abs(nominate_dim1) +
     # party +
        chamber + 
    distance*presidents_party #+ majority
  | Year_x_Agency,
                    cluster = "Legislator",
           data = data_member |> filter(year>2010) )
if(testing){modelsummary::modelsummary(m_staff_count_only_cross, stars = T)}

#### "models_staff_count_only.Rdata"

```{r models_staff_count_only}
models_staff_count_only <- list(
      "(1)" =  m_staff_count_only_cross,
  "(2)" = m_staff_count_only_did,
    "(3)" =  m_house_staff_count_only_cross,
  "(4)" = m_house_staff_count_only_did,
  "(5)" =  m_senate_staff_count_only_cross,
  "(6)" = m_senate_staff_count_only_did
)
rows <- tibble(
  term = c("Dependent variable",
           "All legislators",
           "Only House",
           "Only Senate"),
 `(1)` = c("Count", "X", "", ""),
  `(2)` = c("Count", "X", "", ""),
    `(3)` = c("Count", "", "X", ""),
  `(4)` = c("Count", "", "X", ""),
  `(5)` = c("Count", "", "", "X"),
  `(6)` = c("Count", "", "", "X"),
  )
attr(rows, 'position') <- c(0)
# load(here::here("models", type, "models.Rdata")))
modelsummary(models_staff_count_only) |>
  group_tt(i = list(
    "Demand"= 2,
    "Political Environment" = 10,
    "Political Environment & Capcacy" = 26,
    "Capacity" = 28
  )) |>
  style_tt(i = 44, line = "t", line_color = "black", line_width = 0.2) |>
  style_tt("groupi", background = "grey") |>
  style_tt("~groupi", j = 1, indent = 2)
beta_did <- betas(m_house_staff_count_only_did)
se_did <- standard_errors(m_house_staff_count_only_did)
beta_cross <- betas(m_house_staff_count_only_cross)
se_cross <- standard_errors(m_house_staff_count_only_cross)
save(models_staff_count_only, rows, cm, gm,   beta_cross, beta_did, se_cross, se_did,
     file = here::here("models", type, "models_staff_count_only.Rdata"))
```
